properties.name: Angel Arm
properties.description: A concealed prosthetic arm that releases a devastating energy discharge.

properties.name: Arm Output Limit
properties.description: The arm's discharge is enormous and indiscriminate; it is a last resort because it cannot be fine-tuned.

properties.name: Pacifist Vow
properties.description: Refuses to take a life, even an enemy's.

properties.name: Sharpshooting
properties.description: Extraordinary precision with a revolver; disables weapons and wounds without killing.

properties.name: Plant Resilience
properties.description: Plant physiology: long-lived and quick to recover from injury.

properties.name: Notorious Legend
properties.description: A fearsome reputation that precedes him, at odds with the gentle man himself.

visual_traits.descriptor: tall, lean, loose-limbed frame with a relaxed slouch
round amber-tinted glasses over an easy, open smile
a long red coat with a high collar and buckled straps, dark trousers and boots
saturated red, brass and sun-bleached cream
a large chrome revolver worn low on the hip
a concealed metal forearm whose seams glow white-blue as it charges

exclusion_candidates.reason: A reputation is a narrative role, not a transferable mechanic.
Excluded wherever the vow governs: the discharge is bounded, not released whole.
